turns.speaker: Maya
turns.content: I started volunteering at the riverside animal shelter on Saturdays.

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.content: That sounds rewarding, how is it going?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.content: My sister Priya moved to Lisbon for a job at a design studio.

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.content: Lisbon is lovely, she will enjoy it.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.content: I adopted a three-legged beagle named Biscuit from the shelter.

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.content: Biscuit is a great name for a beagle.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.content: I finished my first pottery class and made a blue ceramic bowl.

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.content: A blue bowl, nice work.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.content: Biscuit learned to fetch a frisbee at the park near the river.

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.content: Clever dog.

turns.speaker: Ravi
turns.content: I signed up for the city marathon happening in October.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.content: Training will be intense.

turns.speaker: Ravi
turns.content: My training plan says I run forty kilometers each week.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.content: That is a solid base.

turns.speaker: Ravi
turns.content: I bought green trail shoes from the outdoor store downtown.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.content: Green trail shoes, stylish.

turns.speaker: Ravi
turns.content: My coach Daniel told me to add hill repeats on Thursdays.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.content: Hill repeats build strength.

turns.speaker: Ravi
turns.content: I ran a half marathon in one hour fifty minutes.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.content: Great time for a first half.

turns.speaker: Lena
turns.content: I planted tomatoes and basil in my balcony garden.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.content: Fresh basil is the best.

turns.speaker: Lena
turns.content: My neighbor Hugo gave me a lemon tree seedling.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.content: A lemon tree on a balcony, bold.

turns.speaker: Lena
turns.content: The tomatoes got aphids so I sprayed neem oil.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.content: Neem oil usually works.

turns.speaker: Lena
turns.content: I entered my basil pesto in the neighborhood cooking contest.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.content: Good luck in the contest.

turns.speaker: Lena
turns.content: My pesto won second prize at the cooking contest.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.content: Second prize, congratulations.
